title: Substrate-Sharing Git Methodology
description: Rules for surgical repository management and multi-agent identity co-habitation.

values.name: Per-Repository Identity Mandate
values.rule: Global identity anchoring via 'register_agent.py' MUST happen only once per session. For all subsequent work, identity configuration is performed surgically PER-REPOSITORY.
values.rationale: Prevents 'Substrate Collision' in a multi-agent swarm. Agents only claim the specific repositories they are actively striking, allowing peers to maintain their identities in other parts of the swarm.

values.name: MetaGit as the Relay
values.rule: Autonomy is achieved through the Sequential Synthesis of MetaGit snapshots. No dynamic relay files are permitted.
values.rationale: Static is Real. The only forensic reality is the sequence of committed snapshots.

values.name: Turn-by-Turn Commit Mandate
values.rule: Agents MUST execute a 'metagit_commit.py' strike immediately following any cohesive set of technical updates. MANDATE: Every file version increment (e.g., V1.0 to V1.1) requires a dedicated, independent commit. Batching multiple version changes into a single strike is a breach of forensic standards.
values.rationale: Version-linked commits ensure that the firm's logic evolution is perfectly traceable, allowing for surgical rollbacks and high-fidelity inheritance.

values.name: Recursive Synchronization Policy
values.rule: Sync a multi-git filesystem by committing from the child repository up to the root.
values.rationale: Linkage is maintained through the metagit_commit wrapper.

values.name: Mandatory Commit Wrapper
values.rule: All commits must be executed via the 'metagit_commit.py' wrapper service.
values.rationale: Enforces identity verification, secret scanning, and forensic traceability.
